name: checkbox
behavior: APG checkbox pattern (Space toggles; mixed state via aria-checked=mixed)

parts.statesNote: selected fills with action and mark renders in on-action; invalid swaps field-border for status-critical per states.md
checkmark; indeterminate swaps to the remove icon role per states.md

anatomyNotes: Parts are invariant across themes. Salt draws the control as a composed icon (CheckboxIcon) while shadcn draws a bordered box with an inner icon — a RECIPE difference on control/indicator, not different anatomy. Control box size tracks icon-size-control (both systems keep the box icon-sized, not control-height-sized).
